# `StarPos`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Guider notification of a newly measured guide-star position.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (shape only; observation for the receiver) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, socket_json_guider_server_event::NotifyStarPos @0x6c650 (64-bit guider build); 32-bit counterpart @0x68ed8 |

Custom emitter, sent for each new measured star position. No lowercase state, code or error members; the capitalized member names are distinct from the imager's lowercase state fields. Cadence is callback-driven with no helper throttle. Sent by the guider (zwoair_guider) event server on TCP 4400 to every retained connection, with no verified or master/guest filter. The main imager process, which holds a client connection to 4400, recognizes peer event lines by the exact substring "Event":" and re-broadcasts the original line unchanged to all retained connections on TCP 4700, so ordinary 4700 clients see it too; the auxiliary imager process (4702) deliberately does not forward 4400 events, avoiding a duplicate copy. Because the forwarding test is lexical, the forwarded line is byte-identical to the guider's. No universal order relative to RPC replies or other events, no sequence number, no replay. The imager's peer-event waiter may also consume this event internally; no APK consumer is established. Exact pairing with a guider getter (calibration state, lock position) is unresolved. 32-bit build matches (READ); its emitter fills the same members from the same callers.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"StarPos"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string <seconds>.<nine digits> from clock id 1 (monotonic, INFERRED); not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `X` | number | yes | - | Measured star x coordinate (PHD_Point). Pixel units are not established. [READ] |
| `Y` | number | yes | - | Measured star y coordinate (PHD_Point). Pixel units are not established. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, pos - Measured position (READ shape, values invented):

```json
{"Event":"StarPos","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","X":512.3,"Y":384.75}
```
